cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Pass Me the Authority
cards.instruction: Get someone to transfer authority publicly by naming you as the person who decides what happens next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Hand me the hall key and tell everyone I'm now in charge.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't I just give you the key? My retirement taxi's waiting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. The door will understand. The committee needs words.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're outside asking me whether to cancel Saturday's dance.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell them I decide whether it goes ahead. Then ask me, in front of them. Your taxi can be my first approval.

mechanism: A corrects a retirement handover from key transfer into a public declaration of decision power, using a live dance question to make B name A successor.
confusable: D57 seeks acknowledgment of status; D60 specifically requires someone to transfer deciding authority publicly to A.
comparison: Meeting alternative corrects private acknowledgement into room-wide declaration; hall alternative uses a live pending event decision.
seedUse: Hall key, retirement taxi, committee and dance question derive from D60-a; S03 adds a precise handover distinction and public redirection.
